page: Microsoft Azure NC8as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 server family. It features an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture and provides 8 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 56.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes a single NVIDIA T4 graphics processing unit with 15 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the instance is provisioned with 360 GB of local storage capacity and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the NC8as_T4_v3 offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads, combining dedicated AMD CPU resources with a mid-range NVIDIA T4 accelerator. This hardware profile is suitable for workloads such as light machine learning inference, data analysis, video encoding, and graphics rendering where a dedicated GPU is required without the cost overhead of high-end accelerator classes.
